name: Costa Rica (1842–1848)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of light blue, white and light blue, with the seal of the Free State of Costa Rica in the centre.
history: After the fall of Braulio Carrillo in 1842 Costa Rica returned to the Central American blue-white-blue triband, now with the state seal in the centre of the white stripe. It was used from September 1842 until 12 November 1848, when the new blue-white-red-white-blue flag designed at the suggestion of Pacífica Fernández was hoisted.

features.role: seal of the Free State of Costa Rica
